cards.title: Family Coping With Child Sexual Abuse Allegations
cards.body: A family is navigating a young adult's disclosure of childhood sexual abuse by a relative. Experts advise prioritizing the victim's safety, allowing them to share at their own pace, and assessing any ongoing danger to younger family members.

cards.title: Empty Nest: Coping When Your Child Leaves Home
cards.body: Parents face unexpected emotional difficulty as their children depart for university, despite knowing this is a natural life transition. The 'empty nesting' phase can bring surprising denial and grief that challenges even prepared families.

cards.title: Second Baby Parenting: What You've Forgotten
cards.body: New parents with a second child often discover they've forgotten basics like feeding, teething, and sleep routines from their first experience. Family support becomes invaluable while nostalgia for a simpler childhood emerges.

cards.title: Taking Toddlers to Music Festivals
cards.body: Bringing young children to music festivals enriches the experience rather than spoiling it, contrary to popular opinion. Families with toddlers add genuine magic to these events through a different perspective on celebration.

cards.title: Parenting Gifted Children: Unique Challenges
cards.body: Advanced learners face distinct educational and developmental challenges that require specialized parenting approaches. Understanding these unique problems helps parents better support their gifted children's growth.

cards.title: Young Teen Struggles With Endometriosis Diagnosis
cards.body: A 14-year-old faced dismissal from doctors who said endometriosis was impossible at her age, forcing her to rely on morphine for pain management. She now advocates for greater awareness of the condition's symptoms in young people.
